description:
The story of a god who wants to become a human and a man who wants to become a god.

Dok-yim, the daughter of Baekho, a creature who wanted to become human out of love for humans. One day, her mother and father, who had gone to the palace, returned as corpses, leaving her alone in the world.

The only person who took her in was Man-myeong. Following Man-myeong, Dok-yim entered the palace for the first time in her life, where she met the treasure of becoming a human and a love she would never forget, On-rang.

Dok-yim, who wanted to become human out of love for them, and the palace people who would stop at nothing to gain or regain the highest power, either to prevent it from being taken away or to obtain it.

This is the story of a god who wanted to become human and a human who wanted to become a god, in "Ho-deok Chronicles."

[Original Webtoon](https://ridibooks.com/books/4291002614)
